name: Covarion.Huelsenbeck02
title: The Huelsenbeck Covarion Model

citation.title: Testing a covariotide model of DNA substitution

args.name: submodel
args.description: The substitution model or mixture used in the ON state

args.name: r
args.description: The sum of the OFF-to-ON and ON-to-OFF switching rates

args.name: pi1
args.description: The equilibrium fraction of time spent in the ON state

description:
Allows sites to switch between an OFF state, in which substitutions do not occur, and an ON state, in which they follow the base substitution model.

When the base model includes rate variation among sites, substitution rates differ among categories but ON/OFF switching rates do not. Unlike scaling the entire Tuffley-Steel covarion model, this lets rapidly evolving sites have the same switching rates as slowly evolving sites.

The OFF-to-ON rate is s01 = r*pi1, and the ON-to-OFF rate is s10 = r*(1-pi1). The computed field rate = 2*r*pi1*(1-pi1) is the equilibrium switching rate before overall substitution-rate normalization.
